enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Body still. Sleep. Continue sleeping. Breathe in. Breathe out. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open door. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wash face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Dry face. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Take out frying pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Transfer eggs to plate. Take bread. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Wait. Take toast out. Put on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Pour milk into glass. Put milk back. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Pick up toast. Eat toast. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine for laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Open basket. Take out clothes. Put clothes into washing machine. Close door. Open detergent compartment. Pour detergent. Close compartment. Set program. Press start. Washing machine runs. Wait.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up and vacuuming the room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up items on floor. Place items on shelf. Pick up cushions. Arrange cushions on sofa. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Vacuum under table. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug. Wind cord. Put vacuum cleaner away. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing grocery shopping early to avoid the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Pick up shopping basket. Walk to produce section. Pick up vegetables. Put in basket. Walk to dairy section. Pick up milk. Put in basket. Walk to meat section. Pick up meat. Put in basket. Walk to checkout. Wait in line. Place items on conveyor. Pay. Put items in bags. Pick up bags. Walk out of store. Walk back home. Unlock door. Enter.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting away the groceries into the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Put bags on counter. Open refrigerator. Take items out of bags. Place vegetables in crisper. Place milk in door. Place meat in drawer. Close refrigerator. Put bags away.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open web browser. Type website address. Scroll through page. Click on links. Read content. Watch video. Adjust volume. Pause video. Resume. Close browser. Close laptop.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Take out pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Rinse plate. Put in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting in the air-conditioned room and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Lie on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Close eyes. Rest. Wake up. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Pick up game case. Open case. Insert game disc. Close console. Sit on sofa. Press start button. Select game mode. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Pause game. Resume. Turn off console. Put away controller.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up and running the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Pick up dirty dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter. Sweep floor.
Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Take out pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Pick up glass. Drink water. Continue eating. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in sink.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll. Type message. Send message. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Turn off TV. Put down remote.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting the alarm, dimming the desk lamp and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm time. Turn off phone. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to desk lamp. Turn dial to dim. Turn off lamp. Walk to bed. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
